title: Berry Protein Overnight Oats
description: Creamy oats with skyr, berries, chia and vanilla protein for a fast post-workout breakfast.
steps: Stir the oats, skyr, milk, protein powder, chia and cinnamon until smooth.
Cover and chill overnight, then loosen with a splash of milk if needed.
Finish with the berries just before eating.

source.label: Adapted from Good Food overnight oats

notes: Prep it the night before so there's zero morning decision-making — ideal fuel within an hour of a fasted session.
